project_type: Full-stack web application: Node.js/Express REST API + React/TypeScript SPA with SQLite database
build_system: npm workspaces - server/ and client/ directories
test_framework: Jest for backend API tests, React Testing Library for frontend
build_command: cd /projects/sandbox/family-tree && npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm install at root. 2. Run npm run build in server/. 3. Run npm test in server/. 4. Run npm run build in client/.
setup_instructions: npm install at project root installs all workspace dependencies
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access available. Node.js 22 pre-installed. Can install any npm packages.
contribution_requirements: Complete replacement of existing repo. New branch for PR.
key_patterns: Replacing entire codebase. New patterns: Express route handlers with controller pattern, Knex.js for SQLite queries, React functional components with hooks, React Flow for graph visualization.
relevant_files: src/main/kotlin/me/self/familytree/beans/Person.kt - data model reference for Person fields
src/main/kotlin/me/self/familytree/beans/FamilyRelations.kt - data model reference for relation types
directory_structure: New structure: server/ (Express API with SQLite), client/ (React SPA with Vite), package.json (workspace root)
